in_hebrew.name: Mella
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Mella הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'melos' which means middle or balance. The name Mella signifies grace, beauty, and harmony. In the Bible, Melchizedek, a king of Salem, is a priest and a king mentioned in Genesis 14. Melchizedek is a name of God meaning King of Righteousness, which aligns with the spiritual meaning of the name Mella.
